ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Meem.[7]
enNotes: [7]- These are among the fourteen opening letters which occur in various combinations at the beginning of twenty-nine sūrahs in the Qur’ān. Although there has been much speculation as to their meaning, it was not, in fact, revealed by Allāh to anyone and is known only to Him.
tr: Alif lām mīm

ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (2) This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh[8] -
enNotes: [8]- Literally, "those who have taqwā," i.e., who have piety, righteousness, fear and love of Allāh, and who take great care to avoid His displeasure.
tr: Dhālikal-kitābu lā rayba fīh, hudal lil-muttaqīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
en: (3) Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer,[9] and spend out of what We[10] have provided for them,
enNotes:
[9]- At its proper times and according to its specified conditions.
[10]- It is to be noted that the reference of Allāh (Subḥānahu wa taʿālā) to Himself as "We" in many Qur’ānic verses is necessarily understood in the Arabic language to denote grandeur and power, as opposed to the more intimate singular form "I" used in specific instances.
tr: Al-ladhīna yuʾminūna bil-ghaybi wayuqīmūnaṣ-ṣalāta wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
en: (4) And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
tr: Wal-ladhīna yuʾminūna bimā unzila ilayka wamā unzila min qablik, wabil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: (5) Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
tr: Ulāʾika ʿalā hudam mir rabbihim waʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (6) Indeed, those who disbelieve[11] - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
enNotes: [11]- Literally, "cover" or "conceal" (faith or truth).
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū sawāʾun ʿalayhim aʾandhartahum am lam tundhirhum lā yuʾminūn

ar: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ غِشَٰوَةٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (7) Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil.[12] And for them is a great punishment.
enNotes: [12]- A covering preventing them from discerning guidance. This condition is a direct result of their arrogance and persistence in sin.
tr: Khatamallāhu ʿalā qulūbihim waʿalā samʿihim, waʿalā abṣārihim ghishāwatuw walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (8) And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
tr: Waminan-nāsi may yaqūlu āmannā billāhi wabil-yawmil-ākhiri wamā hum bimuʾminīn

ar: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (9) They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.
tr: Yukhādiʿūnallāha wal-ladhīna āmanū, wamā yakhdaʿūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūn

ar: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
en: (10) In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease;[13] and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
enNotes: [13]- The "disease" mentioned here includes doubt, hypocrisy, arrogance and disbelief.
tr: Fī qulūbihim maraḍun fazādahumullāhu maraḍā, walahum ʿadhābun alīmum bimā kānū yakdhibūn

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
en: (11) And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
tr: Waʾidhā qīla lahum lā tufsidū fil-arḍi qālū innamā naḥnu muṣliḥūn

ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (12) Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
tr: Alā innahum humul-mufsidūna walākil lā yashʿurūn

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (13) And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.
tr: Waʾidhā qīla lahum āminū kamā āmanan-nāsu qālū anuʾminu kamā āmanas-sufahāʾ, alā innahum humus-sufahāʾu walākil lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (14) And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
tr: Waʾidhā laqul-ladhīna āmanū qālū āmannā, waʾidhā khalaw ilā shayāṭīnihim qālū innā maʿakum innamā naḥnu mustahziʾūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: (15) [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
tr: Allāhu yastahziʾu bihim wayamudduhum fī ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
en: (16) Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīnashtarawuḍ-ḍalālata bil-hudā, famā rabiḥat tijāratuhum wamā kānū muhtadīn

ar: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
en: (17) Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
tr: Mathaluhum kamathalil-ladhistawqada nārā, falammā aḍāʾat mā ḥawlahū dhahaballāhu binūrihim watarakahum fī ẓulumātil lā yubṣirūn

ar: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (18) Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
tr: Ṣummum bukmun ʿumyun fahum lā yarjiʿūn

ar: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (19) Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing[14] of the disbelievers.
enNotes: [14]- Allāh states in the Qur’ān that He has certain attributes such as hearing, sight, hands, face, mercy, anger, coming, encompassing, being above the Throne, etc. Yet, He has disassociated Himself from the limitations of human attributes or human imagination. Correct Islāmic belief requires faith in the existence of these attributes as Allāh has described them without applying to them any allegorical meanings or attempting to explain how a certain quality could be (while this is known only to Allāh) and without comparing them to creation or denying that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) would have such a quality. His attributes are befitting to Him alone, and "There is nothing like unto Him." (42:11)
tr: Aw kaṣayyibim minas-samāʾi fīhi ẓulumātuw waraʿduw wabarq, yajʿalūna aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim minaṣ-ṣawāʿiqi ḥadharal-mawt, wallāhu muḥīṭum bil-kāfirīn

ar: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (20) The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
tr: Yakādul-barqu yakhṭafu abṣārahum, kullamā aḍāʾa lahum mashaw fīhi waʾidhā aẓlama ʿalayhim qāmū, walaw shāʾallāhu ladhahaba bisamʿihim waʾabṣārihim, innallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
en: (21) O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsuʿbudū rabbakumul-ladhī khalaqakum wal-ladhīna min qablikum laʿallakum tattaqūn

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (22) [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
tr: Al-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-arḍa firāshaw was-samāʾa bināʾā, waʾanzala minas-samāʾi māʾan faʾakhraja bihī minath-thamarāti rizqal lakum, falā tajʿalū lillāhi andādaw waʾantum taʿlamūn

ar: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (23) And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.
tr: Waʾin kuntum fī raybim mimmā nazzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā faʾtū bisūratim mim mithlih, wadʿū shuhadāʾakum min dūnillāhi in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (24) But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
tr: Faʾil lam tafʿalū walan tafʿalū fattaqun-nāral-latī waqūduhan-nāsu wal-ḥijārah, uʿiddat lil-kāfirīn

ar: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (25) And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
tr: Wabashshiril-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār, kullamā ruziqū minhā min thamaratir rizqan qālū hādhal-ladhī ruziqnā min qablu waʾutū bihī mutashābihā, walahum fīhā azwājum muṭahharatuw wahum fīhā khālidūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
en: (26) Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller[15] than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
enNotes: [15]- Literally, "above it," i.e., greater in smallness.
tr: Innallāha lā yastaḥyī ay yaḍriba mathalam mā baʿūḍatan famā fawqahā, faʾammal-ladhīna āmanū fayaʿlamūna annahul-ḥaqqu mir rabbihim, waʾammal-ladhīna kafarū fayaqūlūna mādhā arādallāhu bihādhā mathalā, yuḍillu bihī kathīraw wayahdī bihī kathīrā, wamā yuḍillu bihī illal-fāsiqīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
en: (27) Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.
tr: Al-ladhīna yanquḍūna ʿahdallāhi mim baʿdi mīthāqih, wayaqṭaʿūna mā amarallāhu bihī ay yūṣala wayufsidūna fil-arḍ, ulāʾika humul-khāsirūn

ar: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَٰتًا فَأَحْيَٰكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (28) How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
tr: Kayfa takfurūna billāhi wakuntum amwātan faʾaḥyākum, thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum thumma ilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (29) It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself[16] to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.
enNotes: [16]- See footnote to 2:19.
tr: Huwal-ladhī khalaqa lakum mā fil-arḍi jamīʿan thummastawā ilas-samāʾi fasawwāhunna sabʿa samāwāt, wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (30) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority."[17] They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?"[18] He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
enNotes:
[17]- Khalīfah: successor, or generations of man, one following another.
[18]- An additional meaning is "...and we purify ourselves for You."
tr: Waʾidh qāla rabbuka lil-malāʾikati innī jāʿilun fil-arḍi khalīfah, qālū atajʿalu fīhā may yufsidu fīhā wayasfikud-dimāʾ, wanaḥnu nusabbiḥu biḥamdika wanuqaddisu lak, qāla innī aʿlamu mā lā taʿlamūn

ar: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (31) And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
tr: Waʿallama ādamal-asmāʾa kullahā thumma ʿaraḍahum ʿalal-malāʾikati faqāla ambiʾūnī biʾasmāʾi hāʾulāʾi in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (32) They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing,[19] the Wise."[20]
enNotes:
[19]- Whose eternal and absolute knowledge encompasses the truth and essence of all things, seen or unseen, present or absent, neither preceded by ignorance nor followed by forgetfulness.
[20]- Whose wisdom includes precise and perfect knowledge of all realities and outcomes, according to which He decrees and causes various circumstances and occurrences.
tr: Qālū subḥānaka lā ʿilma lanā illā mā ʿallamtanā, innaka antal-ʿalīmul-ḥakīm

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
en: (33) He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."
tr: Qāla yā ādamu ambiʾhum biʾasmāʾihim, falammā ambaʾahum biʾasmāʾihim qāla alam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu ghaybas-samāwāti wal-arḍi waʾaʿlamu mā tubdūna wamā kuntum taktumūn

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (34) And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees.[21] He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.
enNotes: [21]- The proper name of Satan, who was not an angel but from the jinn, as stated in 18:50. Done in obedience to Allāh, this prostration was one of respect, not worship.
tr: Waʾidh qulnā lil-malāʾikatisjudū liʾādama fasajadū illā iblīs, abā wastakbar, wakāna minal-kāfirīn

ar: وَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (35) And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
tr: Waqulnā yā ādamuskun anta wazawjukal-jannata wakulā minhā raghadan ḥaythu shiʾtumā, walā taqrabā hādhihish-shajarata fatakūnā minaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
en: (36) But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
tr: Faʾazallahumash-shayṭānu ʿanhā faʾakhrajahumā mimmā kānā fīh, waqulnahbiṭū baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduww, walakum fil-arḍi mustaqarruw wamatāʿun ilā ḥīn

ar: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (37) Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words,[22] and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance,[23] the Merciful.
enNotes:
[22]- Allāh taught Adam words of repentance that would be acceptable to Him.
[23]- Literally, He who perpetually returns, i.e., reminding and enabling His servant to repent from sins and then forgiving him. Thus, He is also the constant motivator of the repentance He accepts.
tr: Fatalaqqā ādamu mir rabbihī kalimātin fatāba ʿalayh, innahū huwat-tawwābur-raḥīm

ar: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
en: (38) We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
tr: Qulnahbiṭū minhā jamīʿā, faʾimmā yaʾtiyannakum minnī hudan faman tabiʿa hudāya falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (39) And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
tr: Wal-ladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biʾāyātinā ulāʾika aṣḥābun-nār, hum fīhā khālidūn

ar: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
en: (40) O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.
tr: Yābanī isrāʾīladhkurū niʿmatiyal-latī anʿamtu ʿalaykum waʾawfū biʿahdī ūfi biʿahdikum, waʾiyyāya farhabūn

ar: وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهِۦ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
en: (41) And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
tr: Waʾāminū bimā anzaltu muṣaddiqal limā maʿakum walā takūnū awwala kāfirim bih, walā tashtarū biʾāyātī thamanan qalīlā, waʾiyyāya fattaqūn

ar: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (42) And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
tr: Walā talbisul-ḥaqqa bil-bāṭili wataktumul-ḥaqqa waʾantum taʿlamūn

ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرْكَعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
en: (43) And establish prayer and give zakāh[24] and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
enNotes: [24]- An annual expenditure for the benefit of the Islāmic community (see 9:60) required of those Muslims who have excess wealth. Prayer and zakāh are among the pillars of Islām.
tr: Waʾaqīmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātuz-zakāta warkaʿū maʿar-rākiʿīn

ar: أَتَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (44) Do you order righteousness of the people and forget[25] yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
enNotes: [25]- Make exceptions of.
tr: Ataʾmurūnan-nāsa bil-birri watansawna anfusakum waʾantum tatlūnal-kitāb, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: وَٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلْخَٰشِعِينَ
en: (45) And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
tr: Wastaʿīnū biṣ-ṣabri waṣ-ṣalāh, waʾinnahā lakabīratun illā ʿalal-khāshiʿīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
en: (46) Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
tr: Al-ladhīna yaẓunnūna annahum mulāqū rabbihim waʾannahum ilayhi rājiʿūn

ar: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (47) O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].
tr: Yābanī isrāʾīladhkurū niʿmatiyal-latī anʿamtu ʿalaykum waʾannī faḍḍaltukum ʿalal-ʿālamīn

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَٰعَةٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (48) And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul[26] at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
enNotes: [26]- i.e., fulfill what is due from it.
tr: Wattaqū yawmal lā tajzī nafsun ʿan nafsin shayʾaw walā yuqbalu minhā shafāʿatuw walā yuʾkhadhu minhā ʿadluw walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
en: (49) And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
tr: Waʾidh najjaynākum min āli firʿawna yasūmūnakum sūʾal-ʿadhābi yudhabbiḥūna abnāʾakum wayastaḥyūna nisāʾakum, wafī dhālikum balāʾum mir rabbikum ʿaẓīm

ar: وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
en: (50) And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
tr: Waʾidh faraqnā bikumul-baḥra faʾanjaynākum waʾaghraqnā āla firʿawna waʾantum tanẓurūn

ar: وَإِذْ وَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
en: (51) And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.
tr: Waʾidh wāʿadnā mūsā arbaʿīna laylatan thummattakhadhtumul-ʿijla mim baʿdihī waʾantum ẓālimūn

ar: ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (52) Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
tr: Thumma ʿafawnā ʿankum mim baʿdi dhālika laʿallakum tashkurūn

ar: وَإِذْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
en: (53) And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion[27] that perhaps you would be guided.
enNotes: [27]- Differentiating between truth and falsehood. "The Scripture and criterion" refers to the Torah.
tr: Waʾidh ātaynā mūsal-kitāba wal-furqāna laʿallakum tahtadūn

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (54) And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
tr: Waʾidh qāla mūsā liqawmihī yāqawmi innakum ẓalamtum anfusakum bittikhādhikumul-ʿijla fatūbū ilā bāriʾikum faqtulū anfusakum, dhālikum khayrul lakum ʿinda bāriʾikum, fatāba ʿalaykum, innahū huwat-tawwābur-raḥīm

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
en: (55) And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
tr: Waʾidh qultum yāmūsā lan nuʾmina laka ḥattā narallāha jahratan faʾakhadhatkumuṣ-ṣāʿiqatu waʾantum tanẓurūn

ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (56) Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
tr: Thumma baʿathnākum mim baʿdi mawtikum laʿallakum tashkurūn

ar: وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
en: (57) And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.
tr: Waẓallalnā ʿalaykumul-ghamāma waʾanzalnā ʿalaykumul-manna was-salwā, kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum, wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: (58) And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly[28] and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
enNotes: [28]- In gratitude to Allāh and admission of sin.
tr: Waʾidh qulnadkhulū hādhihil-qaryata fakulū minhā ḥaythu shiʾtum raghadaw wadkhulul-bāba sujjadaw waqūlū ḥiṭṭatun naghfir lakum khaṭāyākum, wasanazīdul-muḥsinīn

ar: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
en: (59) But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment [i.e., plague] from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
tr: Fabaddalal-ladhīna ẓalamū qawlan ghayral-ladhī qīla lahum faʾanzalnā ʿalal-ladhīna ẓalamū rijzam minas-samāʾi bimā kānū yafsuqūn

ar: وَإِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ فَٱنفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
en: (60) And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
tr: Waʾidhistasqā mūsā liqawmihī faqulnaḍrib biʿaṣākal-ḥajar, fanfajarat minhuthnatā ʿashrata ʿaynā, qad ʿalima kullu unāsim mashrabahum, kulū washrabū mir rizqillāhi walā taʿthaw fil-arḍi mufsidīn

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَٰحِدٍ فَٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنۢ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِى هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ خَيْرٌ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
en: (61) And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
tr: Waʾidh qultum yāmūsā lan naṣbira ʿalā ṭaʿāmiw wāḥidin fadʿu lanā rabbaka yukhrij lanā mimmā tumbitul-arḍu mim baqlihā waqiththāʾihā wafūmihā waʿadasihā wabaṣalihā, qāla atastabdilūnal-ladhī huwa adnā bil-ladhī huwa khayr, ihbiṭū miṣran faʾinna lakum mā saʾaltum, waḍuribat ʿalayhimudh-dhillatu wal-maskanatu wabāʾū bighaḍabim minallāh, dhālika biʾannahum kānū yakfurūna biʾāyātillāhi wayaqtulūnan-nabiyyīna bighayril-ḥaqq, dhālika bimā ʿaṣaw wakānū yaʿtadūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
en: (62) Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve[29].
enNotes: [29]- After the coming of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) no religion other than Islām is acceptable to Allāh, as stated in 3:85.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū wal-ladhīna hādū wan-naṣārā waṣ-ṣābiʾīna man āmana billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhiri waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn

ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
en: (63) And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."
tr: Waʾidh akhadhnā mīthāqakum warafaʿnā fawqakumuṭ-ṭūr, khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatiw wadhkurū mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūn

ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
en: (64) Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.
tr: Thumma tawallaytum mim baʿdi dhālika falawlā faḍlullāhi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhū lakuntum minal-khāsirīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ
en: (65) And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
tr: Walaqad ʿalimtumul-ladhīnaʿtadaw minkum fis-sabti faqulnā lahum kūnū qiradatan khāsiʾīn

ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهَا نَكَٰلًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (66) And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.
tr: Fajaʿalnāhā nakālal limā bayna yadayhā wamā khalfahā wamawʿiẓatal lil-muttaqīn

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةً قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًا قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
en: (67) And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allāh commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allāh from being among the ignorant."
tr: Waʾidh qāla mūsā liqawmihī innallāha yaʾmurukum an tadhbaḥū baqarah, qālū atattakhidhunā huzuwā, qāla aʿūdhu billāhi an akūna minal-jāhilīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ فَٱفْعَلُوا۟ مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
en: (68) They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
tr: Qāludʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyil lanā mā hiy, qāla innahū yaqūlu innahā baqaratul lā fāriḍuw walā bikr, ʿawānum bayna dhālik, fafʿalū mā tuʾmarūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَآءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ
en: (69) They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"
tr: Qāludʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyil lanā mā lawnuhā, qāla innahū yaqūlu innahā baqaratun ṣafrāʾu fāqiʿul lawnuhā tasurrun-nāẓirīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ إِنَّ ٱلْبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
en: (70) They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."
tr: Qāludʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyil lanā mā hiya innal-baqara tashābaha ʿalaynā, waʾinnā in shāʾallāhu lamuhtadūn

ar: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى ٱلْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا قَالُوا۟ ٱلْـَٰٔنَ جِئْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
en: (71) He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
tr: Qāla innahū yaqūlu innahā baqaratul lā dhalūlun tuthīrul-arḍa walā tasqil-ḥarth, musallamatul lā shiyata fīhā, qālul-āna jiʾta bil-ḥaqqi fadhabaḥūhā wamā kādū yafʿalūn

ar: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَٱدَّٰرَْٰٔتُمْ فِيهَا وَٱللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
en: (72) And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed[30] over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.
enNotes: [30]- i.e., exchanged accusations and denials.
tr: Waʾidh qataltum nafsan faddāraʾtum fīhā, wallāhu mukhrijum mā kuntum taktumūn

ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (73) So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it."[31] Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
enNotes: [31]- i.e., the cow. Thereupon, Allāh restored life to the man, who informed them of his murderer.
tr: Faqulnaḍribūhu bibaʿḍihā, kadhālika yuḥyillāhul-mawtā wayurīkum āyātihī laʿallakum taʿqilūn

ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (74) Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allāh. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
tr: Thumma qasat qulūbukum mim baʿdi dhālika fahiya kal-ḥijārati aw ashaddu qaswah, waʾinna minal-ḥijārati lamā yatafajjaru minhul-anhār, waʾinna minhā lamā yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhul-māʾ, waʾinna minhā lamā yahbiṭu min khashyatillāh, wamallāhu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn

ar: أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (75) Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?
tr: Afataṭmaʿūna ay yuʾminū lakum waqad kāna farīqum minhum yasmaʿūna kalāmallāhi thumma yuḥarrifūnahū mim baʿdi mā ʿaqalūhu wahum yaʿlamūn

ar: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (76) And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allāh has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?
tr: Waʾidhā laqul-ladhīna āmanū qālū āmannā, waʾidhā khalā baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin qālū atuḥaddithūnahum bimā fataḥallāhu ʿalaykum liyuḥājjūkum bihī ʿinda rabbikum, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
en: (77) But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?
tr: Awalā yaʿlamūna annallāha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūn

ar: وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِىَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
en: (78) And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
tr: Waminhum ummiyyūna lā yaʿlamūnal-kitāba illā amāniyya waʾin hum illā yaẓunnūn

ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (79) So woe[32] to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.
enNotes: [32]- i.e., death and destruction.
tr: Fawaylul lilladhīna yaktubūnal-kitāba biʾaydīhim thumma yaqūlūna hādhā min ʿindillāhi liyashtarū bihī thamanan qalīlā, fawaylul lahum mimmā katabat aydīhim wawaylul lahum mimmā yaksibūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَةً قُلْ أَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهْدًا فَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهْدَهُۥٓ أَمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (80) And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for [a few] numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
tr: Waqālū lan tamassanan-nāru illā ayyāmam maʿdūdah, qul attakhadhtum ʿindallāhi ʿahdan falay yukhlifallāhu ʿahdahū am taqūlūna ʿalallāhi mā lā taʿlamūn

ar: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَٰطَتْ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (81) Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
tr: Balā man kasaba sayyiʾataw waʾaḥāṭat bihī khaṭīʾatuhū faʾulāʾika aṣḥābun-nār, hum fīhā khālidūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (82) But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti ulāʾika aṣḥābul-jannah, hum fīhā khālidūn

ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَقُولُوا۟ لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنكُمْ وَأَنتُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (83) And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
tr: Waʾidh akhadhnā mīthāqa banī isrāʾīla lā taʿbudūna illallāha wabil-wālidayni iḥsānaw wadhil-qurbā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni waqūlū lin-nāsi ḥusnaw waʾaqīmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātuz-zakāh, thumma tawallaytum illā qalīlam minkum waʾantum muʿriḍūn

ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
en: (84) And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.
tr: Waʾidh akhadhnā mīthāqakum lā tasfikūna dimāʾakum walā tukhrijūna anfusakum min diyārikum, thumma aqrartum waʾantum tashhadūn

ar: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِهِمْ تَظَٰهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأْتُوكُمْ أُسَٰرَىٰ تُفَٰدُوهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِخْرَاجُهُمْ أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ إِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (85) Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
tr: Thumma antum hāʾulāʾi taqtulūna anfusakum watukhrijūna farīqam minkum min diyārihim, taẓāharūna ʿalayhim bil-ithmi wal-ʿudwān, waʾiy yaʾtūkum usārā tufādūhum wahuwa muḥarramun ʿalaykum ikhrājuhum, afatuʾminūna bibaʿḍil-kitābi watakfurūna bibaʿḍ, famā jazāʾu may yafʿalu dhālika minkum illā khizyun fil-ḥayātid-dunyā, wayawmal-qiyāmati yuraddūna ilā ashaddil-ʿadhāb, wamallāhu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (86) Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīnashtarawul-ḥayātad-dunyā bil-ākhirah, falā yukhaffafu ʿanhumul-ʿadhābu walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ فَفَرِيقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ
en: (87) And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-kitāba waqaffaynā mim baʿdihī bir-rusul, waʾātaynā ʿīsabna maryamal-bayyināti waʾayyadnāhu birūḥil-qudus, afakullamā jāʾakum rasūlum bimā lā tahwā anfusukumustakbartum, fafarīqan kadhdhabtum wafarīqan taqtulūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (88) And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped."[33] But, [in fact], Allāh has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.
enNotes: [33]- Covered or sealed against reception of Allāh's word.
tr: Waqālū qulūbunā ghulf, bal laʿanahumullāhu bikufrihim faqalīlam mā yuʾminūn

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ كِتَٰبٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُوا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَلَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (89) And when there came to them a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] from Allāh confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allāh will be upon the disbelievers.
tr: Walammā jāʾahum kitābum min ʿindillāhi muṣaddiqul limā maʿahum wakānū min qablu yastaftiḥūna ʿalal-ladhīna kafarū, falammā jāʾahum mā ʿarafū kafarū bih, falaʿnatullāhi ʿalal-kāfirīn

ar: بِئْسَمَا ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ أَن يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بَغْيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٍ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
en: (90) How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allāh has revealed through [their] outrage that Allāh would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
tr: Biʾsamashtaraw bihī anfusahum ay yakfurū bimā anzalallāhu baghyan ay yunazzilallāhu min faḍlihī ʿalā may yashāʾu min ʿibādih, fabāʾū bighaḍabin ʿalā ghaḍab, walilkāfirīna ʿadhābum muhīn

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ نُؤْمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ قُلْ فَلِمَ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبْلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (91) And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allāh has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allāh before, if you are [indeed] believers?"
tr: Waʾidhā qīla lahum āminū bimā anzalallāhu qālū nuʾminu bimā unzila ʿalaynā wayakfurūna bimā warāʾahū wahuwal-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqal limā maʿahum, qul falima taqtulūna ambiyāʾallāhi min qablu in kuntum muʾminīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
en: (92) And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.
tr: Walaqad jāʾakum mūsā bil-bayyināti thummattakhadhtumul-ʿijla mim baʿdihī waʾantum ẓālimūn

ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا وَأُشْرِبُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ بِكُفْرِهِمْ قُلْ بِئْسَمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنُكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (93) And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."
tr: Waʾidh akhadhnā mīthāqakum warafaʿnā fawqakumuṭ-ṭūr, khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatiw wasmaʿū, qālū samiʿnā waʿaṣaynā waʾushribū fī qulūbihimul-ʿijla bikufrihim, qul biʾsamā yaʾmurukum bihī īmānukum in kuntum muʾminīn

ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَتْ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (94) Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allāh is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."
tr: Qul in kānat lakumud-dārul-ākhiratu ʿindallāhi khāliṣatam min dūnin-nāsi fatamannawul-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوْهُ أَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (95) But never will they wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
tr: Walay yatamannawhu abadam bimā qaddamat aydīhim, wallāhu ʿalīmum biẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ أَحْرَصَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَوٰةٍ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ يُعَمَّرُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحْزِحِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَن يُعَمَّرَ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (96) And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allāh. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
tr: Walatajidannahum aḥraṣan-nāsi ʿalā ḥayātin waminal-ladhīna ashrakū, yawaddu aḥaduhum law yuʿammaru alfa sanah, wamā huwa bimuzaḥziḥihī minal-ʿadhābi ay yuʿammar, wallāhu baṣīrum bimā yaʿmalūn

ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُۥ نَزَّلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (97) Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down upon your heart, [O Muḥammad], by permission of Allāh, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."
tr: Qul man kāna ʿaduwwal lijibrīla faʾinnahū nazzalahū ʿalā qalbika biʾidhnillāhi muṣaddiqal limā bayna yadayhi wahudaw wabushrā lil-muʾminīn

ar: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (98) Whoever is an enemy to Allāh and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allāh is an enemy to the disbelievers.
tr: Man kāna ʿaduwwal lillāhi wamalāʾikatihī warusulihī wajibrīla wamīkāla faʾinnallāha ʿaduwwul lil-kāfirīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
en: (99) And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.
tr: Walaqad anzalnā ilayka āyātim bayyināt, wamā yakfuru bihā illal-fāsiqūn

ar: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (100) Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
tr: Awakullamā ʿāhadū ʿahdan nabadhahū farīqum minhum, bal aktharuhum lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (101) And when a messenger from Allāh came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allāh [i.e., the Torah] behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].
tr: Walammā jāʾahum rasūlum min ʿindillāhi muṣaddiqul limā maʿahum nabadha farīqum minal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba kitāballāhi warāʾa ẓuhūrihim kaʾannahum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (102) And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Hārūt and Mārūt. But they [i.e., the two angels] do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]."[34] And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allāh. And they [i.e., people] learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But they [i.e., the Children of Israel] certainly knew that whoever purchased it [i.e., magic] would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.
enNotes: [34]- They warn people against the misuse of what they have learned.
tr: Wattabaʿū mā tatlush-shayāṭīnu ʿalā mulki sulaymān, wamā kafara sulaymānu walākinnash-shayāṭīna kafarū yuʿallimūnan-nāsas-siḥra wamā unzila ʿalal-malakayni bibābila hārūta wamārūt, wamā yuʿallimāni min aḥadin ḥattā yaqūlā innamā naḥnu fitnatun falā takfur, fayataʿallamūna minhumā mā yufarriqūna bihī baynal-marʾi wazawjih, wamā hum biḍārrīna bihī min aḥadin illā biʾidhnillāh, wayataʿallamūna mā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum, walaqad ʿalimū lamanishtarāhu mā lahū fil-ākhirati min khalāq, walabiʾsa mā sharaw bihī anfusahum, law kānū yaʿlamūn

ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (103) And if they had believed and feared Allāh, then the reward from Allāh would have been [far] better, if they only knew.
tr: Walaw annahum āmanū wattaqaw lamathūbatum min ʿindillāhi khayr, law kānū yaʿlamūn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُوا۟ ٱنظُرْنَا وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (104) O you who have believed, say not [to Allāh's Messenger], "Rāʿinā" but say, "Unẓurnā"[35] and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
enNotes: [35]- The word "rāʿinā" in Arabic literally means "consider us," i.e., give us time to hear you and listen to us. The Jews used to use the same word with the meaning of an insult. Therefore, the believers were ordered to avoid this expression and use instead the word "unẓurnā," i.e., "wait for us [so that we may understand]."
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā taqūlū rāʿinā waqūlunẓurnā wasmaʿū walilkāfirīna ʿadhābun alīm

ar: مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَلَا ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (105) Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and Christians] nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allāh selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
tr: Mā yawaddul-ladhīna kafarū min ahlil-kitābi walal-mushrikīna ay yunazzala ʿalaykum min khayrim mir rabbikum, wallāhu yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihī may yashāʾ, wallāhu dhul-faḍlil-ʿaẓīm

ar: مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَآ أَوْ مِثْلِهَآ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (106) We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allāh is over all things competent?
tr: Mā nansakh min āyatin aw nunsihā naʾti bikhayrim minhā aw mithlihā, alam taʿlam annallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
en: (107) Do you not know that to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allāh any protector or any helper?
tr: Alam taʿlam annallāha lahū mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wamā lakum min dūnillāhi miw waliyyiw walā naṣīr

ar: أَمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ رَسُولَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلْكُفْرَ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
en: (108) Or do you intend to ask[36] your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
enNotes: [36]- i.e., persistently question or, as in the case of the disbelievers, demand a miracle of the Prophet (ﷺ) .
tr: Am turīdūna an tasʾalū rasūlakum kamā suʾila mūsā min qabl, wamay yatabaddalil-kufra bil-īmāni faqad ḍalla sawāʾas-sabīl

ar: وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِّنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَٱعْفُوا۟ وَٱصْفَحُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (109) Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allāh delivers His command. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
tr: Wadda kathīrum min ahlil-kitābi law yaruddūnakum mim baʿdi īmānikum kuffārā, ḥasadam min ʿindi anfusihim mim baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumul-ḥaqq, faʿfū waṣfaḥū ḥattā yaʾtiyallāhu biʾamrih, innallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (110) And establish prayer and give zakāh, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. Indeed Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr: Waʾaqīmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātuz-zakāh, wamā tuqaddimū liʾanfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿindallāh, innallāha bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (111) And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking. Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
tr: Waqālū lay yadkhulal-jannata illā man kāna hūdan aw naṣārā, tilka amāniyyuhum, qul hātū burhānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
en: (112) Yes, [on the contrary], whoever submits his face [i.e., self] in Islām to Allāh while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
tr: Balā man aslama wajhahū lillāhi wahuwa muḥsinun falahū ajruhū ʿinda rabbih, walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn

ar: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ لَيْسَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُمْ يَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
en: (113) The Jews say, "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus do those who know not [i.e., the polytheists] speak the same as their words. But Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
tr: Waqālatil-yahūdu laysatin-naṣārā ʿalā shayʾ, waqālatin-naṣārā laysatil-yahūdu ʿalā shayʾiw wahum yatlūnal-kitāb, kadhālika qālal-ladhīna lā yaʿlamūna mithla qawlihim, fallāhu yaḥkumu baynahum yawmal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِى خَرَابِهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ أَن يَدْخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (114) And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allāh from being mentioned [i.e., praised] in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmam manaʿa masājidallāhi ay yudhkara fīhasmuhū wasaʿā fī kharābihā, ulāʾika mā kāna lahum ay yadkhulūhā illā khāʾifīn, lahum fid-dunyā khizyuw walahum fil-ākhirati ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm

ar: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (115) And to Allāh belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face[37] of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
enNotes: [37]- See footnote to 2:19.
tr: Walillāhil-mashriqu wal-maghribu faʾaynamā tuwallū fathamma wajhullāh, innallāha wāsiʿun ʿalīm

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
en: (116) They say, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He![38] Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him,
enNotes: [38]- Subḥānahu means "far exalted is He above all they falsely attribute to Him."
tr: Waqāluttakhadhallāhu waladan subḥānah, bal lahū mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, kullul lahū qānitūn

ar: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
en: (117) Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
tr: Badīʿus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, waʾidhā qaḍā amran faʾinnamā yaqūlu lahū kun fayakūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ لَوْلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا ٱللَّهُ أَوْ تَأْتِينَآ ءَايَةٌ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ تَشَٰبَهَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
en: (118) Those who do not know say, "Why does Allāh not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith].
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna lā yaʿlamūna lawlā yukallimunallāhu aw taʾtīnā āyah, kadhālika qālal-ladhīna min qablihim mithla qawlihim, tashābahat qulūbuhum, qad bayyannal-āyāti liqawmiy yūqinūn

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُ عَنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (119) Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muḥammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.
tr: Innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqqi bashīraw wanadhīraw walā tusʾalu ʿan aṣḥābil-jaḥīm

ar: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَلَا ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
en: (120) And never will the Jews and the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allāh no protector or helper.
tr: Walan tarḍā ʿankal-yahūdu walan-naṣārā ḥattā tattabiʿa millatahum, qul inna hudallāhi huwal-hudā, walaʾinittabaʿta ahwāʾahum baʿdal-ladhī jāʾaka minal-ʿilmi mā laka minallāhi miw waliyyiw walā naṣīr

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَتْلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
en: (121) Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital.[39] They [are the ones who] believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers.
enNotes: [39]- i.e., applying its teachings to their lives.
tr: Alladhīna ātaynāhumul-kitāba yatlūnahū ḥaqqa tilāwatih, ulāʾika yuʾminūna bih, wamay yakfur bihī faʾulāʾika humul-khāsirūn

ar: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (122) O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.
tr: Yābanī isrāʾīladhkurū niʿmatiyal-latī anʿamtu ʿalaykum waʾannī faḍḍaltukum ʿalal-ʿālamīn

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا تَنفَعُهَا شَفَٰعَةٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (123) And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul[40] at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.
enNotes: [40]- See footnote to 2:48.
tr: Wattaqū yawmal lā tajzī nafsun ʿan nafsin shayʾaw walā yuqbalu minhā ʿadluw walā tanfaʿuhā shafāʿatuw walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: وَإِذِ ٱبْتَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ رَبُّهُۥ بِكَلِمَٰتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ قَالَ إِنِّى جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (124) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."
tr: Waʾidhibtalā ibrāhīma rabbuhū bikalimātin faʾatammahunn, qāla innī jāʿiluka lin-nāsi imāmā, qāla wamin dhurriyyatī, qāla lā yanālu ʿahdiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْعَٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
en: (125) And [mention] when We made the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf[41] and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."
enNotes: [41]- A form of worship particular to the Kaʿbah consisting of going around it in circuits.
tr: Waʾidh jaʿalnal-bayta mathābatal lin-nāsi waʾamnā, wattakhidhū mim maqāmi ibrāhīma muṣallā, waʿahidnā ilā ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla an ṭahhirā baytiya liṭ-ṭāʾifīna wal-ʿākifīna war-rukkaʿis-sujūd

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُۥ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ أَضْطَرُّهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (126) And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day." [Allāh] said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."
tr: Waʾidh qāla ibrāhīmu rabbijʿal hādhā baladan āminaw warzuq ahlahū minath-thamarāti man āmana minhum billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhir, qāla waman kafara faʾumattiʿuhū qalīlan thumma aḍṭarruhū ilā ʿadhābin-nār, wabiʾsal-maṣīr

ar: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (127) And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing,[42] the Knowing.[43]
enNotes:
[42]- Who hears every sound, distinguishes every voice, understands every word, and accepts and responds to supplications.
[43]- Refer to footnote in 2:32.
tr: Waʾidh yarfaʿu ibrāhīmul-qawāʿida minal-bayti waʾismāʿīl, rabbanā taqabbal minnā, innaka antas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (128) Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
tr: Rabbanā wajʿalnā muslimayni laka wamin dhurriyyatinā ummatam muslimatal lak, waʾarinā manāsikanā watub ʿalaynā, innaka antat-tawwābur-raḥīm

ar: رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (129) Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might,[44] the Wise."
enNotes: [44]- Honored for absolute power associated with wisdom and justice.
tr: Rabbanā wabʿath fīhim rasūlam minhum yatlū ʿalayhim āyātika wayuʿallimuhumul-kitāba wal-ḥikmata wayuzakkīhim, innaka antal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُۥ وَلَقَدِ ٱصْطَفَيْنَٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (130) And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.
tr: Wamay yarghabu ʿam millati ibrāhīma illā man safiha nafsah, walaqadiṣṭafaynāhu fid-dunyā, waʾinnahū fil-ākhirati laminaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥٓ أَسْلِمْ قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (131) When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted [in Islām][45] to the Lord of the worlds."
enNotes: [45]- The meaning of the word "Islām" is "submission to the will of Allāh." This is the way of life ordained by Allāh and taught by all of the prophets from Adam to Muḥammad (ﷺ). A Muslim is one who submits himself to Allāh.
tr: Idh qāla lahū rabbuhū aslim qāla aslamtu lirabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَآ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَٰبَنِىَّ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: (132) And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allāh has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."
tr: Wawaṣṣā bihā ibrāhīmu banīhi wayaʿqūb, yābaniyya innallāhaṣṭafā lakumud-dīna falā tamūtunna illā waʾantum muslimūn

ar: أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِى قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ ءَابَآئِكَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
en: (133) Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac - one God.[46] And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
enNotes: [46]- Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) alone.
tr: Am kuntum shuhadāʾa idh ḥaḍara yaʿqūbal-mawtu idh qāla libanīhi mā taʿbudūna mim baʿdī, qālū naʿbudu ilāhaka waʾilāha ābāʾika ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla waʾisḥāqa ilāhaw wāḥidā, wanaḥnu lahū muslimūn

ar: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (134) That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
tr: Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahā mā kasabat walakum mā kasabtum, walā tusʾalūna ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ تَهْتَدُوا۟ قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (135) They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."[47]
enNotes: [47]- Those who associate others with Allāh in worship.
tr: Waqālū kūnū hūdan aw naṣārā tahtadū, qul bal millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā, wamā kāna minal-mushrikīn

ar: قُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
en: (136) Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allāh and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ][48] and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
enNotes: [48]- The twelve tribes of Israel descended from Jacob.
tr: Qūlū āmannā billāhi wamā unzila ilaynā wamā unzila ilā ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla waʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi wamā ūtiya mūsā waʿīsā wamā ūtiyan-nabiyyūna mir rabbihim, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadim minhum, wanaḥnu lahū muslimūn

ar: فَإِنْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَآ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِى شِقَاقٍ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (137) So if they believe in the same as you believe in, then they have been [rightly] guided; but if they turn away, they are only in dissension, and Allāh will be sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Faʾin āmanū bimithli mā āmantum bihī faqadihtadaw, waʾin tawallaw faʾinnamā hum fī shiqāq, fasayakfīkahumullāh, wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: صِبْغَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ صِبْغَةً وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ عَٰبِدُونَ
en: (138) [And say, "Ours is] the religion of Allāh. And who is better than Allāh in [ordaining] religion? And we are worshippers of Him."
tr: Ṣibghatallāh, waman aḥsanu minallāhi ṣibghah, wanaḥnu lahū ʿābidūn

ar: قُلْ أَتُحَآجُّونَنَا فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُخْلِصُونَ
en: (139) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Do you argue with us about Allāh while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere [in deed and intention] to Him."
tr: Qul atuḥājjūnanā fillāhi wahuwa rabbunā warabbukum, walanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum, wanaḥnu lahū mukhliṣūn

ar: أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ قُلْ ءَأَنتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَتَمَ شَهَٰدَةً عِندَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (140) Or do you say that Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, "Are you more knowing or is Allāh?" And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony[49] he has from Allāh? And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
enNotes: [49]- Statements in previous scriptures attesting to the nature of Allāh's religion (Islām) and the coming of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) .
tr: Am taqūlūna inna ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla waʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭa kānū hūdan aw naṣārā, qul aʾantum aʿlamu amillāh, waman aẓlamu mimman katama shahādatan ʿindahū minallāh, wamallāhu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn

ar: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (141) That is a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
tr: Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahā mā kasabat walakum mā kasabtum, walā tusʾalūna ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَا وَلَّىٰهُمْ عَن قِبْلَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِى كَانُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (142) The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah,[50] which they used to face?"[51] Say, "To Allāh belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."
enNotes:
[50]- The direction faced in prayer.
[51]- Prior to the command (in verse 144) that the Prophet (ﷺ) and his followers turn toward the Kaʿbah in Makkah for prayer, they had been facing Jerusalem to the north. The implications of this change are mentioned in succeeding verses.
tr: Sayaqūlus-sufahāʾu minan-nāsi mā wallāhum ʿan qiblatihimul-latī kānū ʿalayhā, qul lillāhil-mashriqu wal-maghrib, yahdī may yashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِّتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنتَ عَلَيْهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَإِن كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (143) And thus We have made you a median [i.e., just] community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels.[52] And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allāh has guided. And never would Allāh have caused you to lose your faith [i.e., your previous prayers]. Indeed Allāh is, to the people, Kind and Merciful.
enNotes: [52]- i.e., refuse.
tr: Wakadhālika jaʿalnākum ummataw wasaṭal litakūnū shuhadāʾa ʿalan-nāsi wayakūnar-rasūlu ʿalaykum shahīdā, wamā jaʿalnal-qiblatal-latī kunta ʿalayhā illā linaʿlama may yattabiʿur-rasūla mimmay yanqalibu ʿalā ʿaqibayh, waʾin kānat lakabīratan illā ʿalal-ladhīna hadallāh, wamā kānallāhu liyuḍīʿa īmānakum, innallāha bin-nāsi laraʾūfur raḥīm

ar: قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَىٰهَا فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُۥ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
